answer: Pay only above a concentration threshold, not per account. Each identity must gather a walnut-sized harvest of outputs in one epoch: one task counts nothing, a full harvest unlocks a vesting stream. A beacon signal starts the epoch, and an agent that tries to wander its effort across ten clones splits its harvest ten ways, leaving every clone below threshold and earning zero. The stream vests only while the same identity keeps producing at full rate, so clones cannot pool one harvest; a lone honest agent concentrates its work and is paid, while a farm pays full effort per clone for no payout.
